result.title: MaskMerge: Structure-aware Token Merging for Efficient Instance Segmentation
result.summary: Token merging improves the efficiency of Vision Transformers by combining redundant tokens, but existing methods largely rely on feature similarity to determine which tokens to merge. This criterion is effective for semantic segmentation, yet can fail in instance segmentation, where adjacent objects of the same class often have highly similar features. We identify this failure mode as cross-instance token fusion. We introduce MaskMerge, an instance-aware token merging method that uses coarse intermediate mask predictions to constrain feature-based merging and preserve instance boundaries. We evaluate MaskMerge on two diverse instance segmentation domains characterized by high inter-instance visual similarity: PanNuke and iSAID. Against the SOTA token merging method ALGM, MaskMerge improves mAP from 30.1 to 32.1 on PanNuke while reducing computation from 229 to 153 GFLOPs and running 1.18x faster, and from 33.1 to 36.2 on iSAID while reducing computation from 198 to 182 GFLOPs and running 1.23x faster. Additionally, we also test it on Cityscapes and match ALGM's performance while using fewer FLOPs. The gains also transfer to an MAE pretrained backbone, demonstrating that instance-aware merging enables more aggressive compression when appearance similarity alone cannot reliably preserve object identity.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 ViT 实例分割中 token 合并的效率问题，指出仅依赖特征相似度会把同类相邻实例的 token 错误融合（跨实例融合），因此提出 MaskMerge，用粗粒度中间掩码预测约束基于特征的合并以保留实例边界，并在 PanNuke、iSAID 等数据集上验证精度与计算量的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用中间任务预测约束压缩、按实例身份决定哪些视觉 token 得以保留」的思路，可能与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态信息坍缩问题相关，可供核查但并非推理机制研究。
